description: This file defines the interface RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommand, which extends other interfaces related to live commands and thing query commands for retrieving features in a live signal context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturesLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command for retrieving features, providing access to the command and its accessors, and serving as an entry point for creating answer builders.

methods.description: This interface extends other interfaces and does not declare additional methods.
